scope: Private explicit per-Run native-final-text prototype; no production, deployment or target-contract changes.

method.reply: Host binds mode, Run, identity, target and actual delivered sequence before invocation; validated current native final text is published verbatim through existing Worker service.
method.controls: Ordinary CLI conversation, native memory disabled on every launch, same model/effort and continuous session per arm; no model-facing reply schema.
method.trajectory: One preregistered 12-turn pair per model; business errors remain in history and do not trigger reruns; protocol, identity, isolation, missing usage and budget faults stop.
method.accounting: Report provider usage with cache/reasoning conventions, not billing estimates or tokens inferred from byte counts.

verdict: Not general efficiency acceptance; this batch covers only Codex and OpenCode models, not all five CLI families or multi-instance cooperation.

opencode.finding: Four additional generations were business arithmetic tools; zero format-repair or post-final model generations. All 34 observed upstream requests have complete raw-stream usage matching native records.
opencode.limit: One trajectory does not identify causal shares of stochastic tools, declaration, receipts or accumulated history. P146 anomalous output remains unexplained; new captures do not retrospectively resolve it.
